title: Book One · Chapter 142: The Room beyond the Hall
story:
The room is on the other side of the school hall. Ronan has walked past its door many times. Today Miss Wu has the key.

Inside, the air smells of wood and chalk. There is one large window. The long table stands against a wall. Chairs are stacked in the corner. A cupboard is locked. Miss Wu points to the cupboard. It must stay locked when visitors come.

Leo goes straight to the window. “People could see the game from outside.”

“People enter by the door,” Miss Wu says. “Nothing will be passed through the window.”

Mei looks at the wall away from the sun. She wants her pictures there. Bright light can make the colours hard to see. Ronan looks at the place beside her. He could put his map there. People could look at it, then walk to her pictures.

They have brought the plan with the small stones. It is folded along two lines. Leo drew the door opening one way. The real door opens the other way. They turn the plan and change part of it.

Miss Wu asks them to walk the route. Leo pretends to be a visitor. He stops at the game and bends over the table. Mei comes behind him and cannot reach the wall.

“I live here now,” Leo says. He stays in that spot.

“Then I will charge you for the chair,” Miss Wu tells him.

He moves. They laugh, then put the game at the far end of the table. A visitor can stop there to play. Other people can still walk through the door.

Ronan measures the space with a piece of string. Miss Wu writes the real numbers beside it. They get the strips they cut for the pictures. Then they compare the strips with these numbers. Not everything can go on one wall.

“We can choose,” Mei says.

Ronan looks down at his list. He wants the cat and map pictures there. He wants Mr Qiu and Mum in the display. He would like the old-home drawing there too. That last one is not on the list yet.

He thinks about the tree in the old drawing. He thinks about the red bike under it. It is his picture, but it is also part of his family's life.

“I need to ask at home,” he says.

Miss Wu gives him a new sheet for the room plan. She must ask the school about a date. The school must agree to a date first. They cannot invite visitors before then.

They close the window and check the floor. Then they get ready to leave. Leo finds a broken pencil under the table. He puts it on Miss Wu's desk, not in his pocket.

At the door Ronan turns for one last look. The room is empty again. He looks at their new plan for the room. He can think of people standing by the map now.

They are still by the door. Leo asks to carry a chair around the room. He wants to take it around the room. Miss Wu says yes and watches the narrow turn. He holds the chair sideways. It catches on the table. He cannot get past that way. He turns it upright and gets through. Mei marks the chair's place on the plan. It can stay there during the display. No one will carry it through a full room.

After school he takes out his old-home picture. Mum sits beside him. The paper has grown soft at the fold. They look at the tree with Dad's hair at the top.

“I remember this,” she says.

“Would you like it in the school room?”

Mum does not answer at once. “Ask Dad too. And think about your own choice. Do you want everyone to see this picture?”

Ronan keeps the picture on his knee. He has wanted a larger wall for months. He has space to show the old drawing now. But does he want to show it? He looks at the tree again.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：cupboard＝柜子；route＝走动路线；charge＝收费。

情节提示：hall＝礼堂或大厅；upright＝竖直地；fold＝折痕。

理解：1. 原先的房间图为什么需要修改？2. Ronan 为什么没有立刻决定展出旧家的图？
